data.summary:
Accomplished and result-driven Senior Projects Manager with 14+ years of extensive experience leading complex, cross-functional software development and digital transformation initiatives across the Banking and Financial Technology sectors. Proven track record of delivering end-to-end technology programs spanning Global Transaction Banking (iGTB), Core Banking (iGCB), Investment Banking, Corporate Lending, Cash Management, Treasury, and Payments for Tier-1 global financial institutions. Strong expertise in driving large-scale banking transformation, ISO 20022-compliant payment solutions, enterprise application modernization, and digital banking initiatives. Expert in Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project methodologies with a hands-on approach to stakeholder management, multi-million- dollar resource optimization, architecture alignment, risk mitigation, and cross-functional technology leadership
CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
Management: Management (CXO Level), Resource Planning, Budget & Scope Management, Cross-Functional Team Leadership
End-to-End Project Ownership, Agile/Scrum/Waterfall, Risk Mitigation, Stakeholder
Banking Domains: Global Transaction Banking (iGTB), Investment Banking, Core Banking (iGCB), Corporate Lending, Cash Management, Treasury, ISO 20022 Compliance, Real-Time Payment Standards.
Languages & Frameworks:
Java EE, Spring, Spring Boot, Microservices, RESTful APIs, Struts 2.0, Hibernate, Scala, Node.js
DevOps & Cloud:
Docker, Jenkins CI/CD, Kafka, Zookeeper, JFrog, Tomcat, WebSphere, JBOSS
Databases & Tools:
Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, PL/SQL, Git, TortoiseSVN, JIRA, Postman, Rest Assured
Monitoring & Quality:
Prometheus, Grafana, SonarQube, SonarLint\
Clients: MBSB Berhad, Dubai Islamic Bank (DIB), VCB, Citi Bank, Morgan Stanley, Credit Suisse, Bank of Montreal (Loan IQ) – delivering solutions across Transaction Banking, Core Banking, Corporate Lending, and Investment Banking.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Intellect Design Arena Pvt Ltd
Senior Projects Manager — iGTB & Digital Banking Platforms
May 2024 – Present
Own end-to-end delivery of global transaction banking and core banking solutions across proprietary platforms
including iGTB, iGCB, eMach, Purple Fabric, and Capital Alpha.
Drive project lifecycles from initiation to production rollout for major regional and Tier-1 global banks (including
MBSB, VCB, VP, DIB, QNB, BBK, HLBB).
Engage directly with client CXOs and steering committees to report delivery health, manage key milestones, and
mitigate strategic implementation risks.
Lead multi-disciplinary teams composed of Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Developers, QA, and DevOps
engineers across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
Ensure scalable, regulatory-compliant, and high-performance system integrations conforming to ISO 20022 and
real-time payment frameworks.
Loma Technology, Cambodia
Technical Lead
Project: KK Exchange, Platform & Tele-bet Systems
Nov 2022 – March 2024
Defined technical architecture, scope of work, and delivery timelines using Agile Scrum models.
Led frontend and backend engineering teams to construct highly responsive microservices handling real-time
multi-currency exchange fluctuations.
• Built robust Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) for microservices scaling and automated deployment pipelines.
Technology Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST API, MySQL, Hibernate, Docker, Redis, Prometheus, Grafana,
Jenkins, Jira, SonarQube.
Orion Innovation Pvt Ltd (Client: Fiserv Inc.)
Senior Java API Developer / Tech Lead Consultant
July 2021 – Nov 2022
Project: Bank Intelligence (BI) Platform
Designed and deployed enterprise-grade RESTful web services providing advanced spatial and financial
investment insights for banking branches.
Collaborated closely with UI teams (React/Node.js) to streamline structural API payloads and system performance.
Established automated API test suites using Rest Assured framework, minimizing manual UAT cycles by 30%.
Technology Stack: Java 11, Spring Boot, Microservices, Node.js, Oracle, Hibernate, Docker, Git, Maven, Rest Assured,
SonarQube, JIRA.
Eagle Software India Pvt Ltd (Client: Government of Haryana)
Technical Lead
June 2018 – July 2021
Project: Smart City Mission Karnal (KSCL) & eDLVRS (Govt of Nepal)
Directed an engineering group building the Integrated Control, Command, and Traffic Management System for
KSCL.
Architected the end-to-end eDLVRS Vehicle Registration and administrative lifecycle software to automate large-
scale public data registries.
Managed client communication, sprint allocation, code reviews, and cross-functional integration milestones.
Technology Stack: Java 8/7, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Struts 2.0, MongoDB, Oracle 11g, Swing, TortoiseSVN, Tomcat.
Personal Sabbatical
Family Caregiving & Health Management
May 2017 – June 2018
Dedicated a temporary sabbatical to managing critical family healthcare affairs and supporting parental medical
needs.
Maintained technical currency during this period through self-paced research into cloud infrastructure, modern REST
API methodologies, and architectural delivery frameworks.
Virtusa Inc.
Associate Consultant / Application Programmers Lead
Oct 2013 – May 2017
Clients: Bank of Montreal (Commercial Lending) & Credit Suisse (Investment Banking Risk Repository). Worked on enterprise applications supporting syndicated lending, market risk identification, reporting, and production release management.
Implemented Misys Loan IQ configurations to streamline complex syndicated and commercial lending workflows.
Spearheaded development of Core Java enterprise components for risk identification, market scenario
prioritization, and automated reporting.
Managed build/release activities across UAT and production environments, stabilizing critical financial systems.
KSAB Software
Software Engineer
March 2010 – Oct 2013
Developed core web applications using Java/JEE technologies, handling database programming, bug fixes, and unit
testing.
